timestamp_derivation: Read from the workstation clock (UTC+02:00) by the script that wrote this receipt, immediately before the commit that introduces it.
authorisation: The Product Owner's Connectivity Improvements mission of 2026-11-05 (D96): deployment to the test appliance 172.21.96.97 under D79, including migration 0210 and Kea authoritative on its client VLANs.
delivery: The test appliance was upgraded twice with appliance-install.sh --upgrade: to master 51e5030a95a2 (PR #363), applying migration 0210 behind the installer's verified pre-change backup db-20261105T220328Z.sql.gz.age, with netd re-applying the confirmed network configuration so Kea serves the client subnets authoritatively; then to master 12a00cba2092 (PR #367, no migration). Each upgrade passed the Gate-P reconcile (GATEP_RECONCILE = OK) and replaced every service binary and the Admin Console.
verification: Every binary (scd, edged, pmsd, portald, netd, acctd, keybootstrap, svc-run) matched the release by SHA-256, and the release reads back vcs.revision 12a00cba2092, vcs.modified=false; APPLIANCE_UNITS = PASS; schema ledger head 0210; all services active; 444 sessions online after the restart. Live: Kea runs authoritative on both client bridges; netd's address-owner answer was 'owned' for an online device; the first real automatic reconnection after 12a00cba (22:48 UTC, three minutes after the restart) put a device whose 8-hour lease had expired back on its own ACTIVE entitlement as a REJOIN session, with no new entitlement for the stay and the device still AUTHORIZED; the permission refusals seen under 51e5030a stopped at the restart. NOT VERIFIED: a device absent for the full 8-hour lease through the portal page path rather than an OS probe, a randomised-MAC return, and NAK behaviour under a real address collision (none occurred in the observation window).

deployment.test_appliance: onegate-appliance-12a00cba2092; rollback tree /opt/stayconnect/.previous/20261105T224524Z and bin/*.bak-20261105T224524Z (scripts/binary-rollback.sh) back to 51e5030a, and /opt/stayconnect/.previous/20261105T222729Z back to 6935b49b; database rollback: the 0210 down migration (refuses while ADDRESS_CONFLICT rows exist) or the pre-change backup db-20261105T220328Z.sql.gz.age.

not_touched: DHCP lease durations, WAN and management networking, After Check-out Access settings, PMS configuration and postings, payments, licences, the production Central.
